# Block Relics — llms.txt

## What it is
Block Relics is a 100,000-piece NFT collection on BSC: black-and-gold geometric
relic tiles. Any 10 Relics can be forged into 1 dragon Loom. Trading happens on
the project's own bid-only USDT marketplace.

## Status
PRE-LAUNCH. Mainnet contracts are not deployed yet. Nothing on this site moves
funds. All counters and leaderboard rows are preview data.

## Phases & pricing
- 10 phases × 10,000 NFTs. A phase ends the instant it sells out; the next begins
  immediately. Hard cap: 30-day total mint window from launch.
- Token IDs are phase-ranged (phase 1 = 1–10,000, phase 2 = 10,001–20,000, …).
- Mint: $1 USDT in phase 1, +$0.50 per phase ($5.50 in phase 10).
- Max 10 mints per wallet TOTAL across all phases. No free mints (except the
  creator program).

## Agent ID
Free, soulbound (non-transferable), serial-numbered credential — one per wallet.
MANDATORY before minting any NFT and before any buying or selling on the
on-site market. Claim UI reads "Free Agent ID — small fee required"; the exact
total appears in the wallet at signing (small BNB fee to the owner).

## Marketplace (bid-only)
- No sell listings. Buyers place USDT-escrowed bids (per-token or collection);
  bids are cancellable anytime.
- Sellers accept by settling with their OWN signed transaction (they may command
  their own AI). No central executor — quotas, floor, phase gates, Agent ID and
  fees are enforced as preset conditions in the contract code.
- Owner buy-wall floor: $2 + $1/phase ($11 at phase 10, holding after mint end).
  Nobody but the owner can bid below the floor (enforced at placement and at
  execution). Public bidding opens after 1,000 total mints.
- Fee: 2% per trade, sent straight to the owner wallet inside the sale tx.
- External: standard ERC-721, freely tradable on OKX/Element/OpenSea (5% creator
  royalty where enforceable). Bid-only rule and quotas apply on-site only.

## Sell quotas (no selling in phase 1)
Relative to the wallet's first-mint (join) phase J:
- 2–9 mints → selling unlocks at J+1, 1 sale/phase
- 10 mints → unlocks at J+1, 2 sales/phase
- 0–1 mints → unlocks at J+2, then 1 quota every 2 phases
After phase 10 ends, ALL quotas lift. Quota binds to each token under the
minter's Agent ID at mint and travels with the token through free transfers;
only an on-site market sale clears the binding.

## Looms
Burn any 10 Relics → 1 Loom. $0.80 USDT forge fee to the owner. Forging unlocks
after phase 1; loom selling after phase 2. Max 10,000 looms.

## Creator program
5,000 NFT allocation. Eligibility: >1,000 X followers AND >30,000 Telegram
followers. Flow: submit links → follower check → promo post → submit post link +
wallet → free NFT (1 mint quota + 2 extra sell quota/phase). Top 10 creators get
10 looms each after all phases.

## Trading competition ($100,000)
$60,000 NFT pool (≥$1,000 on-site volume to qualify) + $40,000 loom pool
(≥$2,000). Buys and sells both count, credited to both sides. Ranked by volume;
tracked on-chain (nftVolume/loomVolume), frozen by owner via closeCompetition(),
paid after the mint ends. Reward token and rank splits TBA.

## Money flow
Mint revenue and the 2% marketplace fee pay straight to the owner's wallet on
every transaction. Bid escrow sits in the marketplace contract until sale or
cancel (it is the bidder's money).
